title: The Feeding of the Four Thousand
description: After a large crowd had been with Jesus for three days without food, he felt compassion for them. The disciples had only seven loaves and a few small fish. Jesus gave thanks, broke the bread, and had the disciples distribute it to the people. About four thousand people were fed, and seven baskets of leftovers were collected. [ref:Mark 8:1-9|Markus 8:1-9]
